description: This Java class `ArtifactInfoContext` is used for collecting information about various artifact names and locations within the OFBiz framework, such as entities, services, screens, forms, requests, and targets. It provides methods to add and retrieve these names, serving as a context or container for artifact metadata.

classes.name: ArtifactInfoContext
classes.description: A final class designed to gather and store various artifact-related information within a specific context, providing methods to add to and retrieve from internal sets of different artifact types.

methods.name: addEntityName
methods.description: Adds an entity name to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: addFormLocation
methods.description: Adds a form location identifier to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: addRequestLocation
methods.description: Adds a request location identifier to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: addScreenLocation
methods.description: Adds a screen location identifier to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: addServiceName
methods.description: Adds a service name to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: addTargetLocation
methods.description: Adds a target location to the context if it is not null.

methods.name: getEntityNames
methods.description: Returns the set of entity names in this context.

methods.name: getFormLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of form locations in this context.

methods.name: getRequestLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of request locations in this context.

methods.name: getScreenLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of screen locations in this context.

methods.name: getServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the set of service names in this context.

methods.name: getTargetLocations
methods.description: Returns the set of target locations in this context.
